templates.name: Rounded compartment organizer
templates.notes: Broad flat base down, compartments open upward. For dry, non-hazardous desk/craft bits only; not food, liquids, hot objects or safety-critical storage. Radius rounds vertical corners, not the top lip. Compartment size is nominal, not a fit guarantee.
templates.prompt: Make a 120 x 80 x 18 mm organizer for dry desk bits, three compartments, 8 mm corners, 2.4 mm walls and 2 mm base. Preserve the original and show me the geometry and downloads.

templates.name: Rounded multi-pen rest
templates.notes: Base down, open-ended channels upward. Measure your pens; this is a shallow rest, not a clip or friction-fit holder. Rounded ends stay inside the base footprint. Not for hot tools or electrical parts.
templates.prompt: Make a rounded rest for three pens, 80 mm long and 50 mm wide, with 8 mm total height and 6 mm corner radius. Tell me the nominal channel width and show the exported geometry.

templates.name: Paper-card slot stand
templates.notes: Broad base down, slot upward. For lightweight paper/photo cards on a desk only, not phones, tablets or structural loads. The vertical slot has a closed base; measure card thickness and allow clearance. Holding stability and fit are not physically verified.
templates.prompt: Make a stand for a lightweight paper card, 80 x 28 x 12 mm, with a 2 mm vertical slot, 3 mm base and 4 mm corners. Keep the original unchanged and give me a preview plus STL and STEP.
